generic_domain.justification: AI/ML stands for Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. It is a broad field that encompasses various subdomains including but not limited to Neural Networks, Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Generative Models, NLP, Computer Vision, and many more. Other domains listed such as Optimization Algorithms and Algorithms in general are integral components used within AI/ML for tasks like training models, improving performance, and solving complex problems efficiently. Thus, AI/ML is the most generic domain that covers all the specified subdomains.
